entries.title: q_o gives finite literal-action future congruence
entries.body: QO_EQ(q,t) induces an isomorphism of the represented finite future transition structures that keeps each literal column label unchanged.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Induct on remaining rank; the one-step literal-action congruence preserves every existing transition and terminal token.

entries.title: q_r gives finite action-transported future equivalence
entries.body: QR_EQ(q,t) induces an isomorphism of represented finite future transition structures using either c->c or c->6-c consistently with the chosen reflection branch.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Induct on remaining rank through the one-step action-transported bisimulation.

entries.title: q_r orbit contains at most two q_o classes
entries.body: Every QR_EQ equivalence class contains at most two QO_EQ classes: an orientation class and its horizontal reflection.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The quotient is generated by one involution; its group has two elements.

entries.title: reflection stabilizer determines q_r orbit size
entries.body: If REFLECT_Q(q,rq) and QO_EQ(q,rq), q's q_r orbit has one q_o class; otherwise any represented orbit has the original and reflected q_o classes only.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: An involution orbit is a fixed point or a two-element orbit modulo QO_EQ.

entries.title: q_r preserves remaining dependency depth
entries.body: QR_EQ(q,t) implies equal rank and therefore the same 42-rank upper bound on q-step/dependency path length.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Remaining depth bound is a pure function of rank.

entries.title: q_r preserves legal branching cardinality
entries.body: QR_EQ(q,t) preserves the number of legal actions, although reflected pairs may use different literal column labels.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The action transporter is a column bijection preserving LEGAL.

entries.title: q_r preserves represented successor branching cardinality
entries.body: At each paired state, QR_EQ preserves the number of represented Q_STEP successors and immediate terminal actions under the action transporter.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The transporter is bijective and each literal action has at most one successor up to QO_EQ.

entries.title: support equality does not entail raw support-object identity
entries.body: SUPPORT_EQ(S,T) is insufficient by itself to derive EQUAL(S,T) for raw carrier occurrences.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Countermodel: two distinct raw carrier objects may carry identical seven height fields because the theory defines extensional SUPPORT_EQ but contains no object-extensionality axiom collapsing carrier identities.

entries.title: q_o equality does not entail raw q-object identity
entries.body: QO_EQ(q,t) is insufficient by itself to derive EQUAL(q,t).
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Countermodel: two distinct q carrier occurrences may reference extensionally equal support/residual fields; QO_EQ compares content, not carrier occurrence identity.

entries.title: q_r equality does not entail q_o equality
entries.body: QR_EQ(q,t) is strictly weaker than QO_EQ in admissible asymmetric reflected models.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Countermodel: choose a valid asymmetric support/residual content and a separate reflected q occurrence. The reflected branch satisfies QR_EQ while literal orientation-sensitive support differs.

entries.title: scalar value equality does not entail q_r equality
entries.body: VALUE(q,v) and VALUE(t,v) do not in general entail QR_EQ(q,t).
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Countermodel: two distinct full supports with no legal actions, or equal full support with extensionally different valid residuals, both satisfy VALUE(...,0) while q_r content can differ.

entries.title: semantic quotient hierarchy can be strict at every level
entries.body: Raw occurrence identity -> QO_EQ -> QR_EQ -> scalar VALUE equality are progressively weaker scoped relations; none of the reverse implications is generally derivable.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Forward implications are supported by extensional/reflection/value theorems; countermodels witness each missing reverse implication.

entries.title: q_r suffices for scalar cache reuse only
entries.body: QR_EQ is sufficient for reuse of an established scalar VALUE token, but does not by itself identify raw q occurrences or literal action labels.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Value is constant on the orbit while occurrence identity and action coordinates retain residual information.

entries.title: effect class is reflection-equivariant
entries.body: REFLECT_Q(q,rq) and REFLECT_COLUMN(c,rc) imply EFFECT(q,c,e) iff EFFECT(rq,rc,e).
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Veto and distinct completion-cell counts transport bijectively under reflection.

entries.title: reflection preserves the multiset of legal effect classes
entries.body: The legal-action EFFECT multiset of q equals that of any reflected q, after transporting columns.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The reflected column map is a bijection and preserves each effect token.

entries.title: promotion is determined by q_o content
entries.body: QO_EQ(q,t) implies PROMOTE(q,c) iff PROMOTE(t,c) for every literal column c.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Equal orientation-sensitive q content gives identical literal legal/effect relations and the same fixed center-order tie break.

entries.title: promotion is not generally q_r-equivariant
entries.body: QR_EQ does not imply that a promoted literal column transports to the promoted reflected column.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Exact countermodel schema: a reflection-symmetric valid q with equal positive effect at columns 2 and 4 is fixed by QR_EQ, but BEFORE chooses 2; reflection sends 2 to 4, which is not selected because the tie-break remains 2-before-4.

entries.title: ordinary value has no ordering dependency
entries.body: The primitive VALUE support graph contains no EFFECT, BEFORE, or PROMOTE premise; advisory ordering is not part of the ordinary W/D/L definition.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Inspect the exact primitive VALUE/OUTCOME/Q_STEP dependency closure: no ordering relation is referenced.

entries.title: ordering non-equivariance does not threaten q_r scalar value
entries.body: The non-equivariance of PROMOTE under reflection cannot invalidate QR_EQ scalar VALUE reuse.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The value theorem depends on transported game outcomes, not on the advisory evaluation order.

entries.title: q_r alone is insufficient for literal cached move-hint identity
entries.body: A literal move/action hint stored under a q_r class requires orientation/action-transport context; q_r equality alone does not authorize reusing the same numeric column label.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The reflected branch maps c to 6-c rather than preserving literal labels.

entries.title: scalar-only q_r cache needs no orientation for the cached value
entries.body: If a cache entry contains only an exact WDL scalar, orientation metadata is irrelevant to the returned scalar once QR_EQ is verified.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The scalar token is invariant under the identity/reflection transporter.

entries.title: action-bearing q_r cache must preserve a transporter
entries.body: If a q_r cache entry exposes an exact literal action witness, it must preserve enough orientation information to apply c->c or c->6-c on lookup.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Without the transporter a reflected hit can return the wrong physical column even though the scalar value remains correct.

entries.title: q dependency graph is rank-stratified
entries.body: Every Q_DEPENDENCY node occurrence has a rank layer 0..42 and every edge goes from layer n to n+1.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Rank is functional and every edge increments it exactly once.

entries.title: same-rank dependency nodes are unreachable from one another by nonempty paths
entries.body: If two q dependency occurrences have equal rank, neither can reach the other through a nonempty Q_DEPENDENCY path.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Every nonempty path strictly raises rank.

entries.title: dependency path length equals rank difference
entries.body: Any represented Q_DEPENDENCY path from rank n to rank m has exactly m-n edges.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Each edge is one successor increment; composition sums exactly.

entries.title: q_r-equivalent dependency nodes occupy the same rank layer
entries.body: QR_EQ(q,t) implies any dependency occurrences projecting to q and t lie at equal semantic rank.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: q_r preserves rank.

entries.title: q_r scalar sharing is sound across distinct task occurrences
entries.body: Two distinct task occurrences that project to QR_EQ q states may share an already-established scalar VALUE without identifying the task occurrences.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Execution occurrence identity is separate, while scalar VALUE is constant on q_r.

entries.title: task occurrence identity is finer than q projection
entries.body: Projection of two tasks to the same q is not sufficient to derive equality of the task occurrences.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The execution primitive explicitly preserves the equality-versus-disequality alternative for tasks sharing q.

entries.title: q_r does not authorize provenance merging
entries.body: QR_EQ/value reuse cannot by itself merge task, proof, or execution-provenance occurrence identities.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The q_r theorem is scoped to future-game/value content, while occurrence/provenance is separately represented.

entries.title: task-control outcomes are not WDL values
entries.body: ABORTED, RETIRED, SPLIT and CONTINUE are execution-control results and do not constitute VALUE(q,v) assertions.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The result carrier and WDL carrier are distinct, and no primitive implication connects a control token to a WDL token.

entries.title: unfinished control outcomes do not imply a game value
entries.body: RETIRED or SPLIT may hold without any VALUE witness; neither result can be used as an exact WDL assertion.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Task-control predicates depend on flags/budget, not on the VALUE relation.

entries.title: continue does not imply semantic value progress
entries.body: CONTINUE and NEXT_CONTROL constrain only a later polling threshold; they imply no strengthening of VALUE, QO_EQ or QR_EQ.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The primitive control relation contains no semantic-game conclusion.

entries.title: runtime scheduling QU is not a premise of ordinary value
entries.body: The primitive Q_STEP/OUTCOME/VALUE/QR_EQ definitions have no dependency on runtime scheduling QU.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Dependency inspection separates game relations from the execution QU node.

entries.title: runtime QU may change work observations without changing the represented value theorem
entries.body: Different admissible scheduling/work-distribution realizations can alter task/control traces while the same primitive ordinary VALUE relation remains the semantic target.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: QU belongs to execution realization; no QU realization is used to choose a WDL result.

entries.title: distinct-column support steps commute under defined composition
entries.body: For c!=d, whenever S-step-c-step-d and S-step-d-step-c compositions are both defined, their final supports are SUPPORT_EQ.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Independent field increments commute.

entries.title: support commutation does not imply q-step commutation
entries.body: The commutation of SUPPORT_STEP on distinct columns is insufficient to conclude that full Q_STEP moves commute.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Q_STEP also swaps mover side and applies own versus blocker cofactors; reversing two literal moves changes which player owns each placement.

entries.title: residual cofactor commutation does not imply legal game-move commutation
entries.body: Guarded commutation of residual OWN/BLOCK operations is insufficient to reorder alternating legal Q_STEP moves.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Full move semantics also include side ownership, support progression and first-win stopping.

entries.title: first-win stopping is a load-bearing composition barrier
entries.body: A residual-algebra composition may not be lifted to a multi-move game transition across an intermediate OWN_WIN.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: OWN_WIN excludes Q_STEP; no successor exists past the immediate terminal branch.

entries.title: transition fusion must preserve immediate/Q-step exclusivity
entries.body: Any semantics-preserving fused implementation of a Q_STEP path must test/preserve an intermediate immediate win before composing later cofactors or support steps.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Otherwise the fused path would create a successor that the primitive game relation forbids.

entries.title: cofactor reordering is scoped to fixed semantic ownership
entries.body: The exact OWN/BLOCK commutation laws permit reordering only inside a transformation with the same designated owner/blocker roles; they do not authorize swapping which player owns a move.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The algebraic proof fixes operation polarity; alternation changes that polarity.

entries.title: q_o supports scoped future-behavior sameness
entries.body: Under the NEI query 'same orientation-sensitive ordinary future behavior?', QO_EQ supplies exact support for SAME.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The finite literal-action future structures are isomorphic with identity action labels; the identity query is explicitly scoped to that structure.

entries.title: q_r supports scoped reflection-quotiented future sameness
entries.body: Under the NEI query 'same ordinary future behavior modulo horizontal reflection?', QR_EQ supplies exact support for SAME.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The query explicitly quotients by the represented reflection automorphism and action transporter.

entries.title: q equality does not establish physical-occurrence sameness
entries.body: Neither QO_EQ nor QR_EQ alone supports NEI SAME for physical occurrence identity.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Both relations intentionally forget carrier occurrence/provenance distinctions.

entries.title: scalar value equality does not establish future-behavior sameness
entries.body: Equal VALUE tokens alone are insufficient for orientation-sensitive or reflection-quotiented future-behavior SAME.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Scalar value is a strictly coarser property relation in admissible models.

entries.title: q_r does not decide task-occurrence identity
entries.body: QR_EQ can establish scoped future/value equivalence while leaving two execution task occurrences distinct.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Identity scope is explicit: semantic future behavior and task occurrence are different queries.

depth_semantics: longest admitted IA-premise chain from the frozen explicit A0 base; checkpoint round is not assumed equal to derivation depth
